 Lafourche Parish residents encouraged to check for a share of Louisiana’s $10M in unclaimed tax refunds 
 By TYLER ESCHETTE
Gazette Writer 
 Tyler Eschette 
 Gazette Writer

 Residents and business owners throughout Lafourche Parish may be entitled to money they never realized was owed to them, as the Louisiana State Treasury’s Unclaimed Property Program makes than $10 million in uncashed state tax refunds available for immediate claims.
 The Louisiana Treasury recently received a total of $10.05 million from the Louisiana Department of Revenue (LDR), representing unclaimed state tax refunds belonging to thousands of individuals and businesses across Louisiana.
 According to the Treasury, this year’s allocation includes unclaimed refunds associated with 35,265 individuals and businesses statewide.
 The refunds range from relatively small amounts to six-figure sums, meaning some individuals and businesses could have a significant amount of money waiting to be claimed.
 For residents in Lafourche Parish and surrounding communities, the announcement serves as a reminder to check whether an outstanding state tax refund may belong to them.
 The funds are now available for immediate claims through the Louisiana Treasury’s Unclaimed Property Program.
 More than $10 million in unclaimed refunds available 
 Each year, the Louisiana Treasury’s Unclaimed Property Program funds from the Louisiana Department of Revenue associated with state tax refunds that were never cashed.
 LDR previously notified the affected individuals and businesses in August, giving them an opportunity to collect their refunds. However, those who did not respond before the deadline had their unclaimed funds transferred to the Louisiana Treasury’s Unclaimed Property Program.
 Now, the money is available for its rightful owners to locate and claim.
 According to the Treasury, the statewide allocation represents an opportunity for thousands of Louisiana residents and businesses to recover money that may have been overlooked, forgotten or lost track of over time.
 How to search for unclaimed money 
 For residents in Lafourche Parish interested in finding out whether they are owed a portion of the available funds, the process is designed to be simple and accessible.
 Individuals and businesses can search for their names through the Louisiana Treasury’s official Unclaimed Property website.
 To check for unclaimed funds, residents can:
 1. Visit LaCashClaim.org 
 2. Search for their name or business name in the Unclaimed Property database
 3. Review any potential matches and available information
 4. Follow the website’s instructions to submit a claim for property belonging to them
 Residents who need additional assistance can also contact the Louisiana Treasury’s Unclaimed Property Program by telephone at 888-925-4127.
 Louisiana State Treasurer John Fleming encouraged citizens throughout the state to take advantage of the online search and claim process rather than assume they are not owed any money.
 “We have made searching for you name and claiming your money easy,” said Fleming. “Citizens can check online at LaCashClaim.org or call 888-925-4127.”
 Residents are encouraged to search using their current names as well as any previous names they may have used. Businesses should also consider searching under their official business names.
 It is important to remember that finding a potential match does not automatically mean a claim has been approved. Individuals and businesses will need to follow the Treasury’s verification and claim procedures to establish ownership of the funds.
